concerns.text: Task T010 (preprocess) explicitly depends on T004c (split_config.schema.yaml) to validate its output, but T004c is marked [P] (parallel) alongside T004a/b. If T004c is not completed before T010 runs, T010 cannot validate its output against the schema as required. The 'Parallel' tag on T004c is misleading if it is a hard blocking dependency for T010; T004c must be strictly ordered before T010, not just grouped in Phase 1.

Task T012 (test_dataset_schema_validation) depends on T004b (dataset.schema.yaml) and T010 (preprocess). However, T012 is marked [P] (parallel) in the task list. A test that validates a schema cannot run in parallel with the schema definition task (T004b) if the schema file is not yet written. The [P] tag implies no dependencies, but T012 has a hard dependency on T004b's completion.

Task T014 (test_model_output_schema_validation) depends on T005b (model_output.schema.yaml) and T015 (train). T014 is marked [P]. Similar to T012, a contract test cannot run in parallel with the schema definition task (T005b) if the schema file is not yet written. The [P] tag is semantically incorrect for a task that requires the artifact from T005b to exist.

The checkpoint states 'T004b/T005b/T004c (Schemas) MUST be completed before T010/T012/T014'. This contradicts the [P] tags on T004c, T012, and T014 which imply they can run in parallel with other Phase 1 tasks. The text correctly identifies the dependency, but the task tags create a semantic conflict regarding execution order.
